title: Comprehende ReviewDocument
description: Interpretation only: groups, summaries, and hunk pointers. No patch text, file bodies, or blame.

size.description: Human review burden of this change, not file or hunk count. A 40-file mechanical import rename in one layer is small. A 3-file contract rewrite the rest of the stack hangs on can be large.

summary.description: Short what of the whole change. Always write this. Name the stories. Do not invent a motive.

why.description: Generated why for the whole change. Write it from tickets, issues, and/or a coding-agent transcript. Do not paraphrase the patch. Omit when those sources are silent, or when independent stories have different motives. The UI skips the Why section when this is absent.

part.description: Short name of the independent story this ticket belongs to. Same name as the layers in that story. Omit when the ticket is for the whole review.

why.description: Generated why this layer exists. Write it from tickets, commit messages, and/or a transcript when they apply. If this layer has no such source, it may exist to enable later layers in the same story. Do not paraphrase the patch.

summary.description: One sentence: what this layer is.

lookFor.description: Scannable bullets of what to inspect. Not a paragraph.

dependsOn.description: Ids of earlier layers this one depends on. Same story only. Omit when this layer does not depend on other layers.

part.description: Short name of the independent story this layer belongs to. Same name = same story. Different names could have been separate PRs.

hunkRef.description: Copy from comprehende index. Identity is (path, oldStart, newStart), plus oldPath when renamed. Do not guess numbers.
